description: Design examples for #813, not current endpoint requests. Coverage is synthetic: temperature has all four timestamps; precipitation omits 01:00; solar radiation has only 02:00. The missing hours illustrate variable-specific availability, not a defect observed in the real archive. Values and raster reads belong to #815.

instantIntervalExpectation.description: Instantaneous observations use start <= time < end. January's asset extent ends at 23:00 but its observation at 23:00 still belongs to this request; asset extents are only coarse search bounds.

intervalExpectation.description: The requested period is start-inclusive and end-exclusive. For interval-supported data, select observations whose support overlaps that period, retaining their original interval bounds. The first precipitation observation ends at the requested start and is excluded; the last ends at the requested end and contributes its preceding hour. Missing 00:00–01:00 coverage stays missing, not zero.
